purpose: records the current reliable rendering capabilities available to Susan and the Susan-to-Remotion pipeline

standard_short_v1.label: Promo
known_limitations: too short for detailed workflow demos
v2 must stay focused on one main idea

standard_explainer_v1.label: Explainer
standard_explainer_v1.slot_structure: same 11-slot standard structure as standard_short_v1, slower pacing
known_limitations: repo screenshots are not automated yet
uses static repo inspection unless screenshots are supplied

global_limitations: no automated Playwright screenshot capture yet
uploaded logo is currently the only fully implemented asset type from Susan

susan_should_use_this_file_to: prefer repo visual context when product accuracy matters

v2_main_content_clip.authority: Susan's slot plan is the source of truth. Susan's story_beat, visual_suggestion, animation_direction, and remotion_hint for v2 define what must appear on screen. Claude Remotion must not override these with generic patterns.
v2_main_content_clip.required_structure: Exactly 3 structurally distinct phases. Each phase must be a separate Sequence block with its own layout, visual character, and inner useCurrentFrame() scope. The three phases must look and feel different from each other — they are not variations of the same card component.

phase_descriptions.setup_or_launch: Establishes context: the product, brand environment, or starting state of the workflow.
phase_descriptions.action_or_interaction: Shows the product in active use: a workflow step, a game moment, a simulation, an interaction. This phase must feel dynamic and specific to the product.
phase_descriptions.result_or_outcome: Shows the payoff: output, achievement, score, generated result, or CTA bridge.

v2_main_content_clip.product_simulation_requirement: At least one phase must simulate the actual product interface, environment, or workflow using div-drawn mockups. Do not replace this with a decorative text panel or a bullet list. Accepted simulations: game HUD with score/health bars, phone outline with an app screen, terminal window with typed command and output, browser frame with a dashboard or form, chat interface with typing animation.

pattern_by_brand_type.game: Phase 1: garage or build or setup screen. Phase 2: arena or combat or gameplay HUD with active indicators. Phase 3: result or reward or leaderboard.
pattern_by_brand_type.mobile_app: Phase 1: phone mockup with app loading or splash. Phase 2: key feature interaction in progress. Phase 3: output or result state.
pattern_by_brand_type.web_tool_or_saas: Phase 1: browser frame or dashboard skeleton. Phase 2: core action in progress (form, query, generation). Phase 3: output or result displayed.
pattern_by_brand_type.cli_or_dev_tool: Phase 1: terminal window appears with prompt. Phase 2: command being typed with cursor blink. Phase 3: output lines appear with key result highlighted.
pattern_by_brand_type.ai_product: Phase 1: prompt or input interface. Phase 2: generation in progress (typing animation or progress bar). Phase 3: generated output displayed.

v2_main_content_clip.canonical_example: TrailMate V2: Phase 1 = phone outline slides in, app icon animates (product launch context). Phase 2 = scan-line sweeps over a map UI mockup (product in active use). Phase 3 = confidence score result card rises up (product output). Each phase has a completely different visual structure and layout.

production_report.updated_by: the retired render service after Stage 1 Remotion render
production_report.purpose: Documents implementation fidelity vs Susan's slot plan, limitations encountered, fallbacks used, workaround reasoning, and upgrade suggestions. Non-blocking — missing or malformed report never fails the render.
top_level_fields: slots (per-slot: susan_story_beat, susan_visual, implementation_summary, status, deviation, fallback_used, upgrade_suggestion)
render_results (added by the retired render service after Stage 1: slots_ok, slots_failed, export_dir, bridge_project_path)
production_report.quality_observation_notes: severity must be exactly low|medium|high — no other values. For positive/strong moments use type=strong_moment with severity=low.
human_review_needed_when: any slot status is partial, deviated, or fallback_used
repo context was skipped when github_repo was supplied
brand_color was not a valid hex value and palette defaulted
production_report.brand_colour_check: Before writing the report, inspect palette.ts and meta.brand_color. If brand_color is absent, prose, or palette.primary defaulted to #000000 or another fallback: add review_flag, add quality_observation (type=weak_design, severity=high), add system_upgrade_suggestion about separating visual_style from brand_color in Susan.

render_worker_behaviour.after_stage_0: Checks for production_report.json in jobDir. If present and valid JSON: logs overall.status, plan_following_score_self_assessed, review_flags count, and human_review_needed. Logs each flag individually. If present but malformed: logs warning. If missing: logs warning. All non-blocking.
render_worker_behaviour.after_stage_1: If prodReportPath is set and file exists, parses it, appends render_results block (slots_ok, slots_failed, export_dir, bridge_project_path extracted from exportStdout), and re-writes the file. Non-blocking.

antipatterns.name: n_cycling_cards
antipatterns.description: A single card component (FeatureCard, BenefitCard, TestimonialCard, EmojiCard, StepCard, etc.) instantiated N times in a Sequence loop or as explicit repetitions with only text or emoji props varying. This produces a carousel or slideshow regardless of how the component is named.
antipatterns.detection: The same JSX component structure appears 3 or more times in V2 with identical layout; only string or emoji props differ between instances.

antipatterns.name: feature_card_carousel
antipatterns.description: V2 used as a list of product features, each rendered as a uniform card. Common forms: FeatureCard, PillCard, BenefitCard, StepCard with sequential Sequences and different text.
antipatterns.required_instead: Product workflow simulation with 3 structurally distinct phase layouts

antipatterns.name: bullet_list_slide
antipatterns.description: A still-style text layout used inside a video slot. Plain text items staggered in with no structural scene change between them.
antipatterns.required_instead: Visual scene changes between phases; at least one phase must be a product UI simulation

antipatterns.name: visual_description_as_body_text
antipatterns.description: Rendering slot.visual_suggestion or slot.subtext verbatim as on-screen body copy. These fields are production briefs written for Claude, not text intended for the viewer.
antipatterns.required_instead: Only render slot.headline as primary text. Render slot.subtext only if it is clearly brand copy (tagline, handle, supporting statement) — never if it starts with 'An animated', contains 'depicting', 'showing a', or describes a visual.

antipatterns.name: solid_white_background
antipatterns.description: A still slot with background #FFFFFF or near-white with no gradient or decorative element. Compresses below the 50 KB PNG floor.
antipatterns.required_instead: Use a gradient or add decorative elements so the compressed PNG stays above 50 KB
